package.description: A law firm in your CLI — agentic legal assistant for fund-formation documents.

en-US.description: A law firm in your CLI — agentic legal assistant for fund-formation documents.
en-US.longDescription:
Draft, edit, and redline fund-formation documents with an AI agent from the
terminal. Self-contained binary — no Node, Python, API keys, or AWS. Authenticate
with a personal CLI token (swiftlaw login); inference is proxied through the
SwiftLaw backend.
en-US.name: SwiftLaw CLI
